query: How can we pre-specify transparent triangulation rules that upgrade signals from rhetoric to enacted practice and set evidence-strength thresholds for mixed-methods coding?

response.query: How can we pre-specify transparent triangulation rules that upgrade signals from rhetoric to enacted practice and set evidence-strength thresholds for mixed-methods coding?
response.answer: Pre-specify triangulation rules by detailing methods and rationales upfront; set evidence-strength thresholds based on established criteria for mixed-methods rigor.

results.title: Research Methods in Accounting
results.content: Honest and transparent reporting of research practice is an ethical duty of those participating. Researchers should report everything that they did, why
